info.title: NoorixFin API
info.description: Personal and household finance management API. All financial amounts are minor-unit decimal strings. All timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC. Every failure body matches the `ApiErrorBody` schema; branch on its `code`, never on `message`.

cursor.description: Cursor to pass as `since` on the next pull. Advance it ONLY when has_more is false — see the partial-page note in the service.

has_more.description: True if any table hit the row limit. Call again with the same cursor to drain the remainder.

server_time.description: Server time when this delta was computed (ISO-8601).

changes.description: Changed rows per table, keyed by table name.

persona.description: Null until the user reaches §5.2 step 4.

is_super_admin.description: Platform operator flag (DEC-007). The web shell uses this to decide whether to render the System Admin switch. It grants METADATA access only — never access to another user's financial rows.

deletion_scheduled_for.description: Set when status is PENDING_DELETION — when the purge runs.

theme_preference.description: Appearance override; SYSTEM follows the operating system

onboarding_status.description: The step just finished. ACCOUNT_CREATED is absent because it is the initial state — a client asking to move BACK to it is a bug, not a step.

persona.description: Blueprint §5.2 step 4. FAMILY is deliberately absent — DEC-007 dropped family workspaces, and offering a persona the product cannot honour would be the blueprint outvoting a later decision.

opening_balance.description: Opening balance as minor-unit decimal string (e.g., "50000" = 500.00 BDT)

archived.description: Set to true to archive the account

amount.description: Amount in minor units as decimal string (e.g., "125000" = ৳1,250.00)

category_id.description: Category account ID (for income/expense) or destination account (for transfer)

idempotency_key.description: A retry of the same receipt upload returns the original attachment

data_base64.description: Base64 bytes without a data-URL prefix; maximum decoded size 5 MB

ledger_account_id.description: Backing ledger account. Postings reference THIS, not `id`.

translation_key.description: Set for system categories. Translate it for display; also marks the row as system-provided.

custom_name.description: User-supplied name. Overrides translation_key when present.

name.description: Display name. Stored as `custom_name`; also names the backing ledger account.

kind.description: Category kind — matches the backing ledger account class

alert_threshold_pct.description: Warn at this % of the limit. 0 disables.

rollover.description: Whether unspent limit carries into the next period

linked_account_id.description: Account whose balance IS the progress

ledger_account_id.description: The LIABILITY ledger account these terms describe

due_day.description: Day of month the payment is due

due_date.description: Due date in the workspace timezone

reminder_offsets.description: Remind this many minutes before the due time

journal_entry_id.description: The transaction that settled this event

status.description: Pause or resume future processing without deleting the template

minutes.description: How long to trace for. Clamped server-side to at most 60 minutes.

value.description: JSON value for the setting. Shape is per-key.

publish_at.description: ISO timestamp; defaults to publish time

expires_at.description: ISO timestamp; null means no expiry

publish_at.description: ISO timestamp; defaults to publish time

expires_at.description: ISO timestamp; null means no expiry

confirm_email.description: Must exactly equal the signed-in account's email address. A typed confirmation, so an accidental or CSRF-driven POST cannot schedule the deletion of an entire ledger.

reason.description: Optional free-text reason, retained on the audit event.

deviceId.description: Opaque app-generated UUID stored in SecureStore/sessionStorage

pushToken.description: Push token or serialized Web Push subscription

token.description: One-time token read from the pairing QR code

currentDeviceId.description: Keep this device_id active (the caller's own device)

account_id.description: Account affected by every imported statement row

idempotency_key.description: A retry of this import returns the original job

ApiErrorBody.description: The shape of every failure, produced by GlobalHttpExceptionFilter. `code` is the stable identifier — branch on it, not on `message`, which is prose and may be reworded or translated.

requestId.description: Echo of X-Request-ID — quote it when reporting a failure.
